newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES - DECEMBER 6 TO 9.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES - DECEMBER 6 TO 9.

text.p: English and Scottish soccer
fixtures for December 6 to 9:
Friday, December 6:
English F.A. Cup second round - Plymouth v Exeter.
Saturday, December 7:
English F.A. Cup second round - Blackpool v Hednesford,
Cambridge v Woking, Cardiff v Gillingham, Carlisle v Darlington,
Chester v Boston, Chesterfield v Scarborough, Wrexham v
Scunthorpe, Enfield v Peterborough or Cheltenham, Barnet v
Wycombe, Leyton Orient v Stevenage, Luton v Boreham Wood,
Mansfield v Stockport, Walsall v Burnley, Notts County v
Rochdale, Preston v York, Sudbury v Brentford, Bristol City v St
Albans, Watford v Ashford, Hull v Crewe.
English premier league - Arsenal v Derby, Chelsea v Everton,
Coventry v Tottenham, Leicester v Blackburn, Liverpool v
Sheffield Wednesday, Middlesbrough v Leeds, Southampton v Aston
Villa, Sunderland v Wimbledon.
English division one - Barnsley v Southend, Birmingham v
Grimsby, Charlton v Swindon, Crystal Palace v Oxford,
Huddersfield v Norwich, Ipswich v Wolverhampton, Manchester City
v Bradford, Oldham v Queens Park Rangers, Reading v Port Vale,
Sheffield United v Portsmouth, Stoke v Tranmere.
Scottish F.A. Cup first round - Albion v Forfar, Alloa v
Hawick, Elgin v Whitehill Welfare, Huntly v Clyde.
Scottish premier division - Dunfermline v Aberdeen, Hearts v
Raith, Kilmarnock v Dundee United, Motherwell v Celtic, Rangers
v Hibernian.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v Clydebank, Dundee v
Falkirk, East Fife v Partick, Greenock Morton v St Johnstone,
Stirling v St Mirren.
Scottish division two - Livingston v Stenhousemuir,
Stranraer v Brechin.
Scottish division three - Ross County v Montrose.
Sunday, December 8:
English premier league - West Ham v Manchester United.
English division one - West Bromwich v Bolton.
Monday, December 9:
English premier league - Nottingham Forest v Newcastle.
